review_amendment.finding: The Worker applied private headers only when the raw pathname matched the canonical preview pattern. A percent-encoded private namespace could therefore miss the Worker-level private-header branch if the application router decoded it.
review_amendment.change: The Worker now treats the complete /_editorial/ namespace as private after up to two safe URI-decoding passes. Malformed escapes fail closed without throwing. Regression tests cover canonical, unknown, encoded, double-encoded, adjacent public, and malformed paths.

verified.evidence: The route resolves the existing D1-backed session and returns the same non-indexable 404 for missing, creator, expired, unknown, and lookup-failure outcomes. Only role=admin receives the reviewed HTML.
Both bundled HTML artifacts match the reviewed SHA-256 values in v2.3 and the Step-33 implementation record. A hash mismatch returns no preview.

The route is absent from sitemap and public navigation, authenticated access fails as 404 for crawlers, and every private-namespace response receives no-store, noindex, no-referrer, no-script, no-frame headers. robots.txt is defence in depth, not the access control.

v2.3 correctly separates official source canonical URLs from Cite Supply asset URLs. The immutable Step-32 result remains authoritative for the passed read-only production identity, asset rights, source policy, and freshness evidence. No rights or production records changed.

The Worker retains the module-handler shape, uses generated Wrangler binding types, awaits the application handler, and performs no new background or per-request outbound work. Latest inspected @cloudflare/workers-types version: 5.20260926.1.

The route uses an App Router route.ts handler, Promise-based dynamic params, Web Request/Response APIs, and a private URL segment escaped as %5Feditorial in the filesystem. The production build detects /_editorial/preview/:briefId.

Both previews have one H1, accessible SVG title/description, equivalent tables, adjacent method sources, exact metric bindings, and 586/715 substantive words respectively. Interactive browser and assistive-technology QA remains Step 35.

non_blocking_observations: The v2.3 contract retains not_run in its reusable root rights/freshness contract templates and null source-query result slots. The per-preview gate states and immutable Step-32 result are the authoritative execution evidence; release automation must not infer a failure or a pass from those template slots alone.

Google cannot consume X-Robots-Tag on a URL blocked by robots.txt, so privacy does not rely on noindex. The admin session boundary and indistinguishable 404 are the primary controls; robots.txt and noindex are supplementary.
No browser, screen-reader, keyboard, responsive, or external-link interaction result is claimed in this step. Those remain mandatory in Step 35.
No commit, production write, asset mutation, rights mutation, or deployment was performed.

next_step.task: Run authenticated responsive browser, keyboard, accessibility, console, network, and external-link QA for both protected previews at the four required viewports. Do not deploy.
